'''August 2002 Terryville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Terryville, CT on 17 August 2002. It is known from Adam Cregeur's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3918">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-terryville-ct-8-17-2002d3918/ terryville-ct-8-17-2002], DeckTech (Adam "Xzilen" Cregeur, 18 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-terryville-ct-8-17-2002d3918/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 August 2002
* '''Site:''' Terryville, CT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Players:''' 19
